Job Role: SharePoint Developer
Location: Dallas, TX
Duration: 12+ Months Contract
                                                                                           
Job Description: 
1. Manage solution specific SharePoint environment and deployment releases.
2. Experience in development on SharePoint2010/2013.
3. Experience in Solutions development and deployment on SharePoint 2010 while 2013 would be preferred.
4. Effective oral and written communication skills to communicate with various stakeholders at various stages of SDLC.
5. Knowledge of third party tools and their integration with SharePoint would be preferred
6. Should have 5+ years of experience on SharePoint
  
 Skill-  
     
- Visual Studio 2008/2010 or above
- SharePoint designer
- C#
- User controls
- Web Parts
- Site collection/definition
- Custom features
- SharePoint 2010/2013 object model
- MS SQL 2008 and 2012, Basic knowledge
- BCS
- SharePoint 2010 services
- Power shell scripts

 Plus but not required 
• Airline experience
• Experience leading teams and working with on / offshore teams.





 Please forward resume to my Mail Id, as mentioned below, keep subject line as job title & location.
